checkpoint_review: The Router was generally rigorous but slightly lenient on the 'scoop marks' checkpoint. While it marked it false due to resolution, the complete absence of any textural ridges on the visible white surfaces is more indicative of AI smoothing than just occlusion. The Router correctly identified untestable checkpoints (temperature, crystalline structure). I agree with the verdicts but note that the 'glossy finish' checkpoint is partially present (on syrup) but not on the ice cream itself, which the Router noted but didn't penalize heavily.
artifact_review: The Router's detection of 'plastic' strawberries (severity 2.0) is accurate and critical. The 'structural collapse' of the spoon (severity 1.5) is also valid; the right spoon lacks clear definition where it enters the bowl. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these semantic/textural artifacts because it only looks for noise/blur. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask (0.95) confirms the gross shape is correct, but masks often ignore internal texture failures. I agree with the severities; they are moderate but noticeable.
alignment_reasoning: The image aligns well with the 'ice cream' class visually (scoops, bowl, toppings). However, the Fine-Grained Classifier ranked 'chocolate sauce' higher than 'ice cream', suggesting the visual dominance of the topping or a lack of distinct ice cream texture features. The missing 'scoop marks' and overly smooth texture reduce the alignment score from a perfect 5. It is clearly ice cream, but lacks the fine-grained textural fidelity of a real photograph.
artifact_reasoning: Primary artifacts are textural: the strawberries look like plastic/painted models rather than fruit (missing seeds/pores), and the syrup has a uniform, paint-like viscosity. The spoon geometry is soft and merges with the background/bowl rim. These are classic generative artifacts. The severity is moderate (2-3 range) because they don't break the scene's logic but significantly degrade realism.
key_defects: Plastic/waxy texture on strawberry slices (lack of seed detail)
Soft/fused geometry of spoon handles and insertion points
Absence of characteristic ice cream scoop ridges/textures
